verdict.rationale: Docs customization is a fair axis for a documentation platform like Fern, but the evidence pack never mentions themes, colors, fonts, layout options, custom CSS/JS, or custom components. The nearest items are custom domains and custom Ask Fern disclaimer wording, which are not brand theming. The docs.yml 'components' reference in fern-docs-5 is about looking up built-in syntax, not adding your own components.
